subject: Post-demo: SDK auth, routing & observability hooks — next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <dana@atlasai.com>, Tom Hughes <tom.h@atlasai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: SDK auth, routing & observability hooks — next steps

Hi Dana / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo time today — appreciate the clear context on the high-throughput inference use case and the routing needs between short-chat and long-context models. As promised, short recap + proposed next steps so we can make the integration scoped and actionable: 

High-level recap (from Redwood side):
- SDK + auth: you have a short-term preference for API keys for dev/test, and AtlasAI security prefers mTLS for prod. We can support both; will provide snippets for key rotation and an mTLS setup guide.
- Routing/model variants: route by profile ("chat" vs "batch-long"); will show sample header-based routing so you can keep a single endpoint.
- Structured output / tool-calling: recommend schema-first approach — we'll supply examples of model output validation and our tool-calling sample.
- Embeddings / re-ranker: recommend small-batch embedding calls + offline re-ranker; will include sample throughput/latency numbers and quantization guidance.
- Observability hooks: we recommend sending a single trace id header (X-Request-Trace or traceparent) and our SDK will surface token-level latency headers (X-Redwood-Token-Latency) and per-call breakdown (in response headers). We'll provide sample trace header formats and a dashboard template (traces + token latency histogram).

Attachments: attached a short "redwood-sdk-auth-checklist.pdf" and a tiny sample of the trace header format (sample-trace-headers.txt).

Proposed next actions (please reply with ownership / ETA):
1) AtlasAI security — confirm whether you want mTLS for staging or only prod and point person for cert exchange (target: 11/05).
2) AtlasAI dev (Tom) — share a small test dataset and preferred sample request rates so we can calibrate batching recommendations (target: 11/06).
3) Redwood (Monica) — prepare SDK snippet (api key + mTLS) and example routing header; include sample usage for embeddings + re-ranker.
4) Redwood (Lauren) — produce dashboards (Grafana JSON) for token-latency and trace correlation; share a Drive link.

Would you be available for a short follow-up on Thursday 11/05 at 11:00am PT to walk the snippets and security plan? If not, propose 11/06.

Thanks — I’ll pause any internal action until we confirm owners.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
